direction: Studio lighting, tactile surfaces and abstract control symbols. No illustration of the physical Key Light.
hero: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide GitHub README hero banner, approximately 2.5:1 landscape. Create beautifully art-directed premium editorial artwork for 'Open Keylight Chroma'. A dark, refined studio workspace: a beautifully textured walnut tabletop, a small closed charcoal notebook and a matte ceramic coffee cup on the far right, otherwise quiet and spacious. NO lamp, light panel, stand or visible lighting fixture anywhere. The lighting is the subject: graceful cinematic pools of warm amber, pale ivory, restrained coral, and cool cyan light cast across the table and tactile plaster wall. Deep charcoal shadows, photographic material realism, softly graduated light, deliberate negative space, no clutter. On the left exact crisp elegant ivory editorial typography 'Open Keylight' on one line, 'Chroma' on the next, and a smaller line 'Your light. Your firmware.' No other text or logos. Sophisticated quiet craft, not a gaming advert, no neon tubes, no fake hardware, no RGB strips, no watermark. The right half is an atmospheric studio still life, not a product illustration.
plugin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium raster icon for Open Keylight Chroma Stream Deck plugin, square 1024x1024. Original beautifully crafted 3D industrial design miniature, tactile matte graphite, frosted luminous glass, warm ivory and amber with a restrained coral/cyan edge reflection. Seamless nearly black charcoal background filling the square, no outer rounded square tile. One bold, simple silhouette, centered horizontally, situated slightly above center, 20% generous empty space at bottom for dynamic title text rendered by the software. Must remain recognizable at 72 pixels. Orthographic three-quarter lighting, exquisite soft shadows, no text, no letters, no watermark, no busy background, no fine circuitry, no thin outline-only SVG appearance. Subject: a single open square aperture formed by four substantial pieces of frosted optical glass, the upper-right corner deliberately open. White light passes through, subtly refracting amber on the left and cool cyan on the right. An abstract precise luminous aperture representing freedom and light. No lamp, no hardware panel, no stand, no visible bulb. Very simple bold sculptural composition, excellent small-size legibility.
